sections.label: Air and sea hub investment
sections.summary: Air and sea transport contribute over 10% of GDP and 250,000 jobs, and Singapore is investing in Changi Airport expansion and Tuas Port.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Together, they contribute more than 10% of our gross domestic product and 250,000 jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: To anchor Singapore as a world-class air hub and International Maritime Centre, we are investing in the Changi Airport expansion and the next generation Tuas Port.

sections.label: Rail network expansion by 2030
sections.summary: By 2030, Singapore will expand its rail network by 130 kilometres.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: By 2030, we will expand our rail network by 130 kilometres (km).

sections.label: Transport industry transformation jobs
sections.summary: The air, sea and land transport Industry Transformation Maps will create more than 21,000 new jobs by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Through the air, sea and land transport Industry Transformation Maps, we will create more than 21,000 new jobs by 2030.

sections.label: Smart Nation and Future Economy Council
sections.summary: Smart Nation efforts aim to connect living, working and playing for productivity and innovation, while the Future Economy Council strengthens global connections.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Our drive towards being a Smart Nation will better connect the way we live, work and play so that productivity can grow and innovation can flourish.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The work of the Future Economy Council will also strengthen our physical, digital, financial and trade connections to the rest of the world to ensure our relevance.
